## Feature matrix

| Feature | Expected | Actual | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Initial render | Chat panel and greeting visible | | |
| Prompt submission | User and local reply appear | | |
| Keyboard Enter | Form submits once | | |
| Clear conversation | Submitted messages removed | | |
| Minimize / expand | Body and footer hide/show correctly | | |
| Long message wrapping | Text stays within bubble | | |
| Narrow viewport | Layout reflows without horizontal overflow | | |
| Reduced motion | Non-essential animation reduced | | |
| Font failure | Readable fallback is used | | |
| Zoom | Main controls and text remain usable | | |

## Console and network

Record errors, warnings, failed assets, and font request behavior. Do not include private prompt text, credentials, or session identifiers.

## Findings

For each issue, record steps to reproduce, severity, source path, screenshot or sanitized logs, and issue reference.

## Conclusion

State only the browser and version configurations actually tested. Distinguish pass, fail, blocked, and not run. This report does not establish universal browser support or WCAG conformance.
